title: Stars and Moon, Carry Me
subtitle: The travel song on the way to Mars
lyrics: Forest, I'm lifting past your trees,
Wings full of sparkle, heart full of breeze.
The night I loved is falling behind—
But the moon still follows, kind and kind.
Little stars, light my trail,
Silver crumbs on a cosmic sail.
Moon, don't hide, stay close and bright—
I'm flying farther than I've flown tonight.
Chorus
Stars and moon, carry me,
Over the dark and the deep black sea.
I won't give up, I won't grow small—
Happiness travels with me after all.
Glow, little glow, all the way to Mars,
You are my map, you are my stars.
The Earth grows round and blue and far,
A marble spinning like a jar
Of every song the forest knew.
I tuck that song inside me too.
Phobos winks and Deimos hums,
Two shy moons saying, "Here she comes."
Red dust waits like a sleepy shore—
But I'm not lonely anymore.
Chorus
Stars and moon, carry me,
Over the dark and the deep black sea.
I won't give up, I won't grow small—
Happiness travels with me after all.
Glow, little glow, all the way to Mars,
You are my map, you are my stars.
Final chorus
Stars and moon, carry me home
And carry me onward, wherever I roam.
I won't give up, I won't grow dim—
The forest's love is still in me, within.
Glow, little glow, on a brand-new world…
Fairy and firefly, wings unfurled.
placement: Balloon-rocket flight from Earth to Mars (after the Sun, before Phob & Deim).

title: Song for a Sad Moon
subtitle: Comfort for Luma while she stays dark
lyrics: Hello, moon, why so still?
Your silver face looks tired tonight.
Did the clouds sit heavy on you,
Or did you lose a piece of light?
You don't have to shine the whole sky alone.
Even you can rest a little while.
The stars will keep the dark from feeling empty
Until you find your quiet smile.
If you feel far, I'm still down here.
If you feel dim, I see you anyway.
Sad moons still matter. Sad moons still guide.
You can be soft and still light the way.
So lean on the night if you need to.
Cry silver if you have to cry.
When you're ready, rise again slowly.
We'll wait. We're not saying goodbye.
Glow when you can. Rest when you can't.
You're loved even when you fade.
Sad moon, you're still our moon.
You don't have to be perfect to stay.
placement: Pip (or the town) sings this to dark Luma. Pairs with Luma's Sad Song.

title: Things That Glow
subtitle: Theme song — glow doesn't have to be giant
lyrics: Fireflies write letters in the grass.
Night-lights hum in a sleepy room.
A jar of lightning bugs. A porch lamp.
A smile that finds you in the gloom.
The moon hangs like a lantern.
Stars pin sparkles to the black.
A candle on a windowsill.
The eyes of a cat coming back.
Dew can catch a little sun.
A screen can make a tiny day.
A heart can light a hallway
When someone kind has something to say.
Glow doesn't have to be giant.
Glow can be a speck, a spark, a crumb.
Glow can be a bug, a moon, a laugh,
Or the warmth when someone says, "I'm here. Come."
So if the dark feels bigger than you,
Remember all the things that shine:
Bugs and moons and kitchen lights
And the brave little glow that's mine.
placement: Opening theme or end-credits; montage under Pip's tour of lights.
